design: Same frozen ordinary Transformer + Huber(delta=1) + 0.1 EMD encoder/checkpoint; train two conditional joint density heads
base_precision: bf16 autocast; same as saved reference predictions
condition: 128 frozen embedding features standardized with training statistics + 4 original point z-scores
target_transform_fit: full training targets only; physical truth kept unchanged for metrics
training_objective: negative joint log density in standardized transformed target space
eligibility_rule: Prefer candidates with all four Res <= local VyPER Res and all four local Trace >= local VyPER Trace; if none qualify, retain best-score candidate for diagnosis and label primary_eligible=false
checkpoint_selection: eligible candidates first, then minimum validation mean of 12 log ratios: Res/baseRes, baseTrace/Trace, W1/baseW1, four observables; all metrics from the same fixed-seed single-draw prediction
selection_weights: equal 1/12; exploratory geometric compromise, not a declaration of superiority or a paper metric
trace_normalization: all events in each truth bin, including out-of-range predictions; average diagonal, not event-weighted accuracy
reporting: same single-draw set: Res, local Trace, W1, MAE, RMSE, bias
32-sample observable mean and median: each receives its own complete metric profile
pooled posterior: each event total weight one; report separately
baseline predictions rechecked against the original Huber+EMD file
full event counts, cache and checkpoint hashes, epochs, updates, GPU and elapsed time
shared_cache_cost: separate GPU stage, included in reported total method costs along with prior encoder training
smoke: Both heads train one complete full-data epoch and evaluate all validation events; production blocked unless both pass
limitations: validation used for selection, no test claim
new heads do not by themselves establish originality or paper superiority
equal wall-time budgets, not equal epochs or parameter counts
